verifiedMeaning: Date on which a maintainer manually reviewed the exact effective resource URL and its action label. Automated HTTP checks never set or refresh this date.

serviceStatus.fresh: Every dated resource is at most freshDays old and no resource lacks review metadata.
serviceStatus.review-due: At least one dated resource is older than freshDays but not older than reviewDueDays.
serviceStatus.stale: At least one dated resource is older than reviewDueDays.
serviceStatus.unverified: At least one resource has no evidence-backed review date. This status makes no claim that the URL is dead.
